subject: general
question: In May 2025, which Indian minister announced the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) development plans at the CII Business Summit?
solution: The correct answer is __**Rajnath Singh**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Rajnath Singh**, the Defence Minister of India, announced the development plans for the **Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA)** during the **CII Business Summit** in May 2025. • The **AMCA** is an ambitious indigenous program aimed at developing a **5th-generation stealth fighter aircraft** for the Indian Air Force (IAF). • This project is being developed by **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)** in collaboration with the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**. • The AMCA program will include state-of-the-art features like **stealth technology, supercruise capability, advanced avionics, and AI-based systems**. • The announcement reflects the Indian government’s focus on **Atmanirbhar Bharat (Self-Reliant India)** by encouraging indigenous defence manufacturing and reducing dependency on foreign technology.
